messages:
Noah: Noticed a transient double-bill seen in console for a streaming resume + toolcall case at 08:41. Tagging @Priya (metering) and @Elena (router).

Priya: please paste trace id and a short timeline.

Noah: trace tr_91a, sess ss_900. Timeline: start stream -> prefix 100 tokens -> network hiccup -> client resume -> router handed to different backend -> provisional claim created twice (p1,p2 same hash) -> confirms show two lines then consolidation reconciles to single usage. ledger snippet: 
[2026-03-10T08:41:01Z] ledger: provisional p1 trace=tr_91a tokens=50 hash=0xabc
[2026-03-10T08:41:04Z] ledger: provisional p2 trace=tr_91a tokens=50 hash=0xabc
[2026-03-10T08:41:06Z] ledger: confirm p1 -> c1
[2026-03-10T08:41:07Z] ledger: confirm p2 -> c2
[2026-03-10T08:41:09Z] reconcile: merge c1,c2 -> c1 tokens=50 (refund issued)

Elena: router likely didn't forward resume_key/parent_provisional on handoff.

Priya: mitigation options: (1) router: forward parent headers on handoff; (2) ledger: coalesce confirms that share a prefix hash within a short grace window and atomically confirm only one; (3) console: collapse provisional rows and show "merged" badge.

Noah: I prefer 2+3: implement confirm-coalesce in ledger (CAS by provisional-hash) and console collapse to reduce customer panic. Router change as follow-up.

BillingBot: Scheduled canary: ledger/coalesce-confirm -> 2026-03-11T01:00Z (us-east-1 low traffic).

Elena: note: ensure toolcall-invoke passes parent_provisional header during resume flows to avoid separate provisional bucket.

Priya: will draft PR for ledger coalesce with CAS on hash key and tests for concurrent confirms. Also add `merged_ids` metadata to confirmed record and `suppress_refund` when tombstoning.

Noah: great. I'll open a console UX ticket to collapse provisional duplicates and surface merge link to trace.

Elena: thanks team. monitor provisional_merge_rate and transient_confirm_rows in the dashboard after canary.

Priya: will post PR link when ready.
